local_bottleneck: At least one director/trustee resident in India (182+ days) needed; separate 12A/80G and FCRA processes add months.
deduction: 50% (some 100%) deduction of donation to 80G-registered charities; 30% of adjusted gross income cap.
foreign_donor_restriction: FCRA 2010 registration with MHA mandatory for foreign funds; 20% admin cap, no sub-granting, renewal every 3 yrs.
corrections: confirm prior - Sec 8 needs 1+ director resident in India 182 days; 12A/80G + FCRA are separate follow-ups.

local_bottleneck: Resident Pakistani director/secretary (Sec 21) or trustee required; FBR tax-exempt status is a separate application.
deduction: Deductible if FBR-approved; capped at 25% of adjusted taxable income (individuals).
foreign_donor_restriction: None notable - no FCRA-style licensing; banks apply standard AML/repatriation compliance.
corrections: confirm prior - Sec 42/21 license route via SECP under Companies Act 2017 confirmed; 2018 charitable regulations apply.

local_bottleneck: 2/3 of NGO board must be Bangladeshi citizens; NGO Affairs Bureau controls foreign-funded NGOs (2016 Act).
time_to_register: 4-12 weeks, if Bangladeshi-citizen board is feasible
deduction: Deductible for donations to government-recognized charitable organizations, subject to limits.
foreign_donor_restriction: Foreign-funded NGOs must register with NGO Affairs Bureau (2016 Act); foreign currency account permission; cancellable.
corrections: confirm prior - NGO Act 1961 s.3 2/3 Bangladeshi-citizen board rule; 2016 Foreign Donations Act replaces 1978 Ordinance.

local_bottleneck: Local registered office + bank account needed; 12B exemption and Approved Charity status are separate IRD steps.
deduction: Deductible for donations to Minister-listed Approved Charities; capped at assessable income.
foreign_donor_restriction: International NGOs must register (ROC/NGO unit) to receive foreign funds; no FCRA-style licensing regime.
corrections: confirm prior - trust route via Registrar-General (Trusts (Amend) Act 2018) confirmed; no citizenship requirement for trustees.

local_bottleneck: Trust needs local address/representative; foreign funding needs Social Welfare Council approval (discretionary).
deduction: Deductible for donations to registered charitable organizations/associations.
foreign_donor_restriction: Foreign NGOs must register with SWC; Foreign Contribution Act governs receipt of foreign funds.
corrections: confirm prior - Trust Act 2064 (2007) route confirmed for foreigners; NGO route needs 5 of 7 Nepali-citizen board.

local_bottleneck: CSOs must be Bhutanese-citizen formed; foreign NGOs need a local host MoU + CSO Authority approval.
time_to_register: 6-16 weeks, if a local sponsor is secured
deduction: Deduction for donations to government-recognized charitable organizations; very small tax base.
foreign_donor_restriction: Foreign CSOs need CSO Authority registration + MoU with a Bhutanese host organization; government approval required.
corrections: confirm prior - governing law is Civil Society Organizations Act 2007 (amended 2022), not 'NGO Act 2008'; no direct foreign formation.

local_bottleneck: Post-2021 Taliban de-facto NGO licensing (Ministry of Economy + sectoral MoU); sanctions block most funding.
time_to_register: months, if possible; not a practical option
foreign_donor_restriction: De-facto NGO license + MoU required; US/UN sanctions restrict funds to Afghanistan; most donors suspended.
corrections: confirm prior - registration now under de-facto Taliban NGO law (2022 procedure), not the 2015 NGO law; not practical.

local_bottleneck: Resident local trustees/representative + Maldivian office required; MIRA tax-exemption approval is a separate step.
deduction: Deductible for donations to MIRA-approved charitable organizations under the Income Tax Act.
foreign_donor_restriction: None notable - no FCRA-style licensing; registered public trusts may receive foreign funds (banking compliance).
corrections: confirm prior - public trust registered with Ministry of Justice; MIRA approval (MIRA 103) is for tax exemption, not registration.
